chunks: "If he steals in prison, he is to be executed."

key_terms.السِّجْنِ: the prison; the place of confinement
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated; a report transmitted without a full sanad/isnad here
key_terms.قُتِلَ: he was executed; put to death as punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a prisoner commits theft while in prison?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling concerning repeated theft committed while already imprisoned. It indicates a severe penal consequence within the context of criminal law and judicial punishment in Shia fiqh literature.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If he steals while in prison, he is to be executed."
